implemented_on_integration: Barrot V3 remains the execution, orchestration, safety, authorization and verification foundation.
Public XRP collector uses HTTPS host allowlisting, rejects redirects, bounds response size, captures source timestamps/HTTP provenance and rejects stale cached observations.
RawReceiptArchive verifies byte-exact SHA-256 payloads, content-addressed paths, canonical receipt IDs, per-run append-only hash chains and cross-run chain continuity.
License-sensitive or incomplete publisher data can be retained as digest-only research receipts with explicit retention reasons and excluded from model eligibility.
SQLite point-in-time feature store enforces captured/available-at semantics and as-of retrieval; its own documentation explicitly disclaims adversarial tamper resistance.

Chronological walk-forward evaluation includes naive class-prior, momentum, mean-reversion and volatility-normal baselines, temporal probability calibration, PSI drift monitoring and paired temporal/source-cluster bootstrap.
Forecast ledger is fail-closed and requires readiness evidence; no unsupported directional forecast is emitted.
XRP event timeline and counter-hypothesis generation are present.
